status: Specified before the frozen-workload integration runs.
scope: Learning preservation and cost instrumentation using unchanged standard-library protection algorithms.
primary_endpoint: Exact parameter preservation at every round across transport policies with the same learning seed
contexts: One required level per client and round, shared across directions and models; independent NumPy RNG seed+20000, probabilities [0.244,0.712,0.044]
adaptive_policy: Minimum-required-level policy with an explicitly declared synthetic context trace.
communication: One full FP32 model download and one full FP32 upload per client per round; fresh-key wrapper unchanged
byte_boundary: Raw tensor bytes plus measured key/ciphertext/signature/nonce/tag lengths and existing AAD length; excludes packet framing, TLS, certificates and architecture/schema transfer
time_boundary: Sequential host round execution including training, serialization, protection, decoding, aggregation and audit instrumentation; no measured network transmission or parallel device latency
memory_boundary: Whole isolated worker peak RSS including interpreter, libraries, data loading, training and audit state vectors
timing_summary: Average three repeated executions within each learning seed; summarize three seed means; repeats are not independent learning seeds
energy: No new physical device energy claim
